clip_kinds.description: Clip kinds this behavior draws from (roster kinds, not instance names).

interrupt.description: When a bus event may pre-empt this behavior.

pacing.description: Mean seconds between occurrences, PER EXTERNAL MODE (modes are declared by the scene's input bus: e.g. unwatched/watched/empty/night). Replaces the v1 report's prose pacing table — this IS the table, as data.

zones.description: Zone names (environment) this behavior may occupy.

reactions.description: Event-driven responses: external bus events and other characters' events land here first, before the pacing policy.

play.description: Behavior id to run on this event (e.g. alert).

then_weight_boost.description: Temporary weight multipliers applied after the reaction (v1 contract: after APPROACH, fishing is boosted while watched).

to_mode.description: Switch the external mode (e.g. APPROACH -> watched).

trigger.description: Bus event name (scene inputs) or character event type.

species.description: Species package id this behavior set belongs to.
